messages:
rachael: Quick sync — need to finalize SI co-sell handoff rules before Tue org review. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/si-co-sell-draft (please add comments)

sam: Link looks solid. Suggest SI rep logs lead in Salesforce and tags @partnerships for visibility. Minimal fields: SI rep, Redwood AE, lead source, stage.

vipul: Add SLA: SI must acknowledge/claim leads within 24h or lead returns to Redwood queue. Conflict resolution owned by Partnerships.

olivia: Agree — add 'no double-pursuit' rule and escalation path to Partnerships lead. +1 on 24h SLA.

rachael: Proposed ROE (copy into playbook):
```
1) SI files lead in SF (field: SI_Rep)
2) Redwood AE adds mapping tag and confirms ownership within 24h
3) If both claim, Partnerships triggers tie-breaker within 48h
4) SI executes intro + discovery, logs next steps in SF
5) Revenue/credit per MOU; legal sign-off before contract
```

kevin: For revenue credit, propose: SI 30% first year for services-led deals; 15% for platform deals. Open to feedback.

suresh: Legal has MOU template ready, will upload to Drive and link it in sheet. Need mandatory NDA step for early-stage prospects.

partnerships-bot: Reminder: New SI intake form live -> https://forms.redd/si-intake. Responses auto-populate partner-leads sheet.

rachael: Thanks all. Final ask: annotate the mapping sheet (columns: SI, Redwood AE, GEO, Priority) by EOD Mon. We'll consolidate for GTM doc. :pray: 

olivia: I'll add APAC timezone mapping and local SI contacts.

sam: I'll prototype an automated SF flow: set owner to `SI - <name>` then webhook to Partnerships queue for tracking.

rachael: Great. Also let's test the flow with Acme Corp lead this week. Who can own the test run?

kevin: I'll own Acme test. Ping me with lead details.

rachael: Awesome, thanks everyone — closing thread.
